3. Calculate D = slope / 6 (Einstein relation for 3D)

Conversion factor:

- 1 ps = 1e-12 s

<action_input>{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/react/melting/task/level_2/brief/silicon_melting_2_trial_1/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD (4th column)

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps
timestep = 0.001
time = steps * timestep

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# For diffusion coefficient, we need the linear region
# Typically, we skip the initial ballistic regime and use the later linear part
# Let's use the last 80% of the data for fitting
start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time))
time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t (in 3D)
# So slope = 6*D
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (in Angstrom²/ps)
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Angstrom² = 1e-20 m²
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom²/ps = 1e-20 / 1e-12 = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\n=== Diffusion Coefficient Calculation ===")
print(f"Linear fit range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Number of data points used: {len(time_fit)}")
print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom²/ps")
print(f"R² value: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6e}")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient (D):")
print(f"  D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom²/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion Coefficient Calculation Results\n")
    f.write(f"=========================================\n\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Number of data points: {len(time_fit)}\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6e}\n\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient:\n")
    f.write(f"  {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n\n")
    f.write(f"Final answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}\n")

# Create a plot showing the fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data', alpha=0.7)
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('MSD vs Time with Linear Fit', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_fit_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f"\nPlots saved: msd_plot.png, msd_fit_plot.png")
print(f"Results saved: diffusion_coefficient.txt")
"}</action_input>
